title: Aesthetic Korean Style Bag DIY 🎀  #bag #sewing
description:
Sew this trendy corduroy mini bag with me! 🧵✨ 
This chic dome purse is the perfect weekend project for anyone who loves handmade fashion. I’m obsessed with how this corduroy texture looks in this soft pink shade. It’s compact, stylish, and surprisingly easy to make even if you're just starting your sewing journey. In this Short, I’m showing you a quick breakdown of the process. 

You’ll see how we go from fabric scraps to this adorable high-end looking accessory. If you’ve been looking for a sign to start a new creative project, this is it! Grab your sewing machine and let’s get crafty together. Want to see every detail and measurement?
Check out the full step-by-step tutorial already live on my channel: https://youtu.be/M5XVzgKM3kI

❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy

✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 Main fabric
🔹 Fusible fleece (180g)
🔹 Non-woven stabilizer
🔹 33 cm (13") zipper
🔹 14 cm (5.5") zipper
🔹 Lining fabric
